1021-1315-6303-6763.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

147-2511-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-3875-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3875-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3240-4247-6351-6462.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

277-2557-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-2557-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1003-1778-6516-7039.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1778-6516-7039.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1621-2350-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3899-4552-5159-7704.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a copy of Spawning Pit that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform using Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing another creature, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

430-2743-6222-6753.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-6222-6753.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Exalted Sunborn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Repeat.
2263-4050-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4475-7450.description:
Cast Pox Plague by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, discard half their hand, and sacrifice half their permanents, rounded down. Ensure that you don't sacrifice Wound Reflection.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
4475-7450.notes: Each opponent with an odd life total will have 1 life remaining. Each opponent with an even life total will have 0 life and lose the game.

4120-4186-6798-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
4120-4186-6798-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3490-4369-4659-5719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-4659-5719.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Molten Gatekeeper triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Molten Gatekeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Molten Gatekeeper triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

147-997-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

2034-2557-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2557-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

250-779-1479-4862-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4862-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

7-2191-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2191-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 2.

3200-4195-4316-4574.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2511-3086-3175.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.

1737-4853-5004-5315.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

222-527-955-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-955-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

3388-3607-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its persist ability and its static effect.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it and River Kelpie's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Repeat.

791-3693-5427-6093.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5427-6093.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-4659-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4659-5958.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Repeat.

1636-2292-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2292-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

204-392-969-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

509-2347-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Idris.
509-2347-3525.description:
Activate Idris using Firemind Vessel's ability by tapping it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

2292-4881-5011.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2525-2947.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Double, adding {C}{C}.
Body Double leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat.
